title: Numerical cipher letter to "Mr ?ilick" at Amsterdam, 1632?, Riksarkivet Chifferklaver låda II:133 (DECODE R4306; from catalogue item 207)

documents.shelfmark: Riksarkivet, Chifferklaver låda II:133 (wrapper II:104), DECODE R4306

transcription.notes: First transcription r4306_transcription.txt (492 tokens, 51 distinct, measured 14 Oct 2026); r4306_v2.txt keeps the scribe's variant forms (34/74, 40/4o/9o, 30/3o/70/7o): 465 tokens, 62 distinct. Whether the variants are distinct symbols is not settled.

system.summary: Numbers 5-203 separated by colons, mostly 30-52; the index of coincidence (0.073 on the first transcription) points to one sign per letter, but no language fits.
system.notes: '34 42' occurs 31 times. The type is a hypothesis from the statistics, not established. Split on 14 Oct 2026 from riksarkivet1628 (catalogue 207).

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Fetched the 14 DECODE records of catalogue 207 with the project cookie; R4306 (Chifferklaver låda II:133, to "Mr ?ilick" at Amsterdam, "1632?") is one of four unrelated groups.

Simple-substitution and homophonic annealing of R4306 over quadgram models in nl, de, la, fr, sv, en, it, es, pt, da; first runs collapsed to e/n strings until a search bug (free changes propagating by swaps) and a backoff-model artefact were fixed.
R4306 re-transcribed keeping digit variants (55 tokens); annealed again.
Fetched 70 Chifferklaver låda II key records (R4259-R4329); tested the Siebenbürgen key (R4310) and the 1632 word-end-30 key (R4296) on R4306 (and R4284): no fit.
Split from the former catalogue-207 group entry riksarkivet1628 under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026); R4306 is a cipher of its own. Both transcriptions re-measured. No new attack.

outcome.method_basis: Simple-substitution and homophonic annealing over quadgram models in ten languages, on two transcriptions, gave no plaintext, and the two box keys tested do not fit.
outcome.fraction_read_source: targets/riksarkivet4306/r4306_v2.txt: 465 tokens, none with a value.

gaps.detail: annealing in ten languages failed on both transcriptions; the digit-variant question is open; only 2 of the 70 fetched key records tried

outcome.notes: Split on 14 Oct 2026 from riksarkivet1628. Attempted, open: the other box keys and the digit variants are not settled.
